platformOrderHint: Check the box to fetch tags from stated platform, drag & drop to reorder fallback
overwriteHint: When disabling toggle, you can select which tags to overwrite alternatively
id3VersionHint: Use ID3v2.4 instead of IDv2.3 for MP3/AIFF files
shortTitleHint: Write title without version, currently supported for Beatport & Traxsource only

mergeGenresHint: Merge the fetched genre & styles with existing ones, instead of replacing
camelotHint: Write Camelot key 8A, 8B ... instead of musical key Am, C ...

skipTaggedHint: Skip tracks with the 1T_TAGGEDDATE tag (One Tagger Tag)
yearOnlyHint: Write just the year instead of full date
multiplatform: Tag same track on multiple platforms

removeCoversHint: Removes all existing covers if overwriting album art
parseFilenameHint: Valid variables are: %track%, %artist%, %title%, etc. anything in between % % gets treated as dynamic content
moveSuccessful: Move succesfully tagged files after tagging
moveFailed: Move files that failed to get tagged
enhancedLrcHint: Write per-word timestamps into LRC (if available). Not all players support this.
albumRatio: How many % of tracks must be from same album to be treated as album:
genreStyleHint: Fetch all (default), merge them, or write elsewhere (supported platforms only)
strictnessHint: The higher, the more accurate results, but less potential matches
threadsHint: The higher, the faster, but uses more bandwidth, and not supported by all platforms
postCommand: EXECUTE COMMAND WHEN TAGGING IS FINISHED
postCommandHint: $success and $failed will be substituted with paths to files containing paths of affected tracks

spotifyLoggedIn: You are successfully logged in to Spotify
unlimitedSearches: This platform allows unlimited concurrent searches

createPlatform: How to create a custom platform?
inputHint: Drag & drop a folder, paste a path directly, or click the browse icon
selectTagsHint: Check the box to fetch stated tag

totalHint: Total amount of files to process
